title: Programmer’s guide
body:
Architecture

packages/basic contains profile data, tokenizer/parser, Program, Machine, BasicSession and VirtualDevices. Program stores sorted source and compiles statements into a bounded AST instruction list. IF becomes branch/jump instructions; DATA is indexed separately. Machine evaluates AST nodes directly. BASIC text is never passed to eval, Function, browser DOM or a shell.

BasicSession owns source, dialect, seed, live execution and virtual media. It implements environment commands and emits source/output/state/edit/device events. The browser app communicates with it through a Blob Worker built from local source. Each step yields after at most 500 instructions. A separate UI watchdog terminates an unresponsive Worker. The terminal view uses textContent and native inputs. Trusted game adapters are separate modules and are absent from public-candidate packages.

Standalone module API

import {Program, Machine} from './index.js';
const program = new Program('10 PRINT 2+3\n20 END');
const machine = new Machine(program, {
  dialect: 'ms8k', seed: 'tutorial', write: text => console.log(text)
});
while (machine.status === 'running') machine.step();

The runtime package exports Program, parseLine, tokenize, Machine, BasicSession, VirtualDevices, profiles, profileFor, limits, deviceLimits, seededRandom, exportWorkspace and importWorkspace. Machine.status is running/input/stopped/ended/error. At input call machine.input(text); stop()/cont() preserve a live run. Inspect machine.error for a line diagnostic. Constructors accept dependency injection for random, write, clock, budgets and devices.

The synchronous example is for a trusted host/test. Untrusted programs must run in an isolated Worker or equivalent process, with unchanged finite budgets and validated messages. Do not expose an untrusted caller to random/write/clock callbacks or budget overrides. The browser Computer supplies this boundary. A Worker is not a distinct security origin; reviewed host JavaScript and CSP remain part of the trust boundary.

Session protocol

Use session.load(source,dialect,seed), command(text), tick(), stop(), beginEdit(line), commitEdit(text), cancelEdit() and device(action,data). Tick schedules work while status is running. Events include source, output, state, notice at the Worker wrapper, edit/edit-end, devices and device-export. Worker requests have exact allowlisted fields. The optional iframe layout protocol accepts only its parent/frame, same origin, version/type, token and bounded height; it never carries BASIC commands or saves.

Extending responsibly

Keep syntax and semantics profile-specific; add small independent programs before full-game acceptance. A new device backend should preserve mount/open/write/peek/advance/eof/catalog/import/export contracts and enforce limits. Never infer host paths from BASIC names. Add any new portable format as a validated versioned contract; do not serialize arbitrary VM objects. BBC support would need its own profile and tests, not a global change to existing profiles.

Build and tests

Project builds use Node’s standard filesystem libraries and a deterministic local bundler; there are no production npm dependencies. Unit tests use node:test. Browser QA uses development-only Playwright engines. Private historical references/oracles are not shipped. Original examples, safety tests, all four dialects, source/media round trips and release file inventories are independently checked. The standalone runtime is reusable without Grav or the browser UI.
